<description>
Kills mutant https://mutanthub.space/mutants/4675:

```diff
diff --git a/src/consensus/tx_check.cpp b/src/consensus/tx_check.cpp
index 473538e..d484547 100644
--- a/src/consensus/tx_check.cpp
+++ b/src/consensus/tx_check.cpp
@@ -32,11 +32,11 @@ bool CheckTransaction(const CTransaction& tx, TxValidationState& state)
     CAmount nValueOut = 0;
     for (const auto& txout : tx.vout)
     {
-        if (txout.nValue < 0)
+        nValueOut += txout.nValue;
+        if (nValueOut < 0)
             return state.Invalid(TxValidationResult::TX_CONSENSUS, "bad-txns-vout-negative");
         if (txout.nValue > MAX_MONEY)
             return state.Invalid(TxValidationResult::TX_CONSENSUS, "bad-txns-vout-toolarge");
-        nValueOut += txout.nValue;
         if (!MoneyRange(nValueOut))
             return state.Invalid(TxValidationResult::TX_CONSENSUS, "bad-txns-txouttotal-toolarge");
     }
```

This mutant could lead to an inflation bug, and the only other check that prevents that is in `GetValueOut`.
</description>
